arxiv-1812-08836.title: Automatic Quality Assurance and Release
arxiv-1812-08836.creator: Bram Adams, Benoit Baudry, Sigrid Eldh, Andy Zaidman, Gerald Schermann
arxiv-1812-08836.description: Abstract . This report documents the program and the outcomes of Dagstuhl Seminar 18122 “Automatic Quality Assurance and Release”. The main goal of this seminar was to bridge the knowledge divide on how researchers and industry professionals reason about and implement DevOps for automatic quality assurance.

arxiv-2010-02554.title: Recyclable Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2010-02554.creator: Pablo Moreno-Muñoz, Antonio Artés-Rodríguez, Mauricio A. Álvarez
arxiv-2010-02554.description: Abstract We present a new framework for recycling independent variational approximations to Gaussian processes. The main contribution is the construction of variational ensembles given a dictionary of fitted Gaussian processes without revisiting any subset of observations. Our framework allows for regression, classification and heterogeneous tasks, i.e. mix of continuous and discrete variables over the same input domain.

arxiv-2105-05215.title: Doubly invariant subspaces of the Besicovitch space
arxiv-2105-05215.creator: Amol Sasane
arxiv-2105-05215.description: Abstract . A classical result of Norbert Wiener characterises doubly shift-invariant subspaces for square integrable functions on the unit circle with respect to a finite positive Borel measure μ \mu , as being the ranges of the multiplication maps corresponding to the characteristic functions of μ \mu -measurable subsets of the unit circle.

arxiv-2304-10827.title: Users volatility on Reddit and Voat Corresponding author: W. Quattrociocchi (email: walter.quattrociocchi@gmail.com).
arxiv-2304-10827.creator: Niccolò Di Marco 1 , Matteo Cinelli 2 , Shayan Alipour 2 , and Walter Quattrociocchi 2
arxiv-2304-10827.description: Abstract Social media platforms are like giant arenas where users can rely on different content and express their opinions through likes, comments, and shares. However, do users welcome different perspectives or only listen to their preferred narratives? This paper examines how users explore the digital space and allocate their attention among communities on two social networks, Voat and Reddit.

arxiv-2305-18394.title: On Optimal Regularization Parameters via Bilevel Learning
arxiv-2305-18394.creator: Matthias J. Ehrhardt, Silvia Gazzola, Sebastian J. Scott
arxiv-2305-18394.description: Abstract Abstract Variational regularization is commonly used to solve linear inverse problems, and involves augmenting a data fidelity by a regularizer. The regularizer is used to promote a priori information and is weighted by a regularization parameter. Selection of an appropriate regularization parameter is critical, with various choices leading to very different reconstructions.

arxiv-2308-08956.title: Probabilistic Gradient-Based Extrema Tracking
arxiv-2308-08956.creator: Emma Nilsson, Jonas Lukasczyk, Talha Bin Masood, Christoph Garth, Ingrid Hotz
arxiv-2308-08956.description: Abstract Feature tracking is a common task in visualization applications, where methods based on topological data analysis (TDA) have successfully been applied in the past for feature definition as well as tracking. In this work, we focus on tracking extrema of temporal scalar fields.

arxiv-2411-12693.title: Peculiar Dust Emission within the Orion Molecular Cloud
arxiv-2411-12693.creator: Parisa Nozari, Sarah Sadavoy, Edwige Chapillon, Brian Mason, Rachel Friesen, Ian Lowe, Thomas Stanke, James Di Francesco, Thomas Henning, Qizhou Zhang, Amelia Stutz
arxiv-2411-12693.description: Abstract It is widely assumed that dust opacities in molecular clouds follow a power-law profile with an index, β \beta . Recent studies of the Orion Molecular Cloud (OMC) 2/3 complex, however, show a flattening in the spectral energy distribution (SED) at λ > 2 \lambda>2 mm implying non-constant indices on scales ≳ \gtrsim 0.08 pc.

arxiv-2505-14446.title: Light deflection in unified gravity and measurable deviation from general relativity
arxiv-2505-14446.creator: Mikko Partanen, Jukka Tulkki
arxiv-2505-14446.description: Abstract Light does not travel in a perfectly straight line when it passes near massive objects. Instead, it follows the curvature of spacetime as predicted by general relativity. In this work, we apply the gauge theory of unified gravity [Rep. Prog. Phys. 88 , 057802 (2025)], formulated as an extension of the Standard Model to include gravity.

pmc-10631324.creator: Jung-Min Yu, Wan-Ming Chen, Ben-Chang Shia, Szu-Yuan Wu
pmc-10631324.description: PurposeTo investigate the impact of statin use on primary prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) in a dose-, class-, and use intensity-dependent manner.MethodsWe used an inverse probability treatment-weighted Cox hazards model, with statin use status as a time-dependent variable.

pmc-10704701.creator: Vered Buchholz, Riley Hazard, Dong-Kyu Lee, David S Liu, Wendell Zhang, Sharon Chen, Ahmed Aly, Stephen Barnett, Peter Le, Laurence Weinberg
pmc-10704701.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundTextbook outcomes is a composite quality assurance tool assessing the ideal perioperative and postoperative course as a unified measure. Currently, its definition and application in the context of oesophagectomy in Australia is unknown.

pmc-11548306.title: Classification and Identification of Frequency-Hopping Signals Based on Jacobi Salient Map for Adversarial Sample Attack Approach
pmc-11548306.creator: Yanhan Zhu, Yong Li, Tianyi Wei
pmc-11548306.description: Frequency-hopping (FH) communication adversarial research is a key area in modern electronic countermeasures. To address the challenge posed by interfering parties that use deep neural networks (DNNs) to classify and identify multiple intercepted FH signals—enabling targeted interference and degrading communication performance—this paper presents a batch feature point targetless adversarial sample generation method based on the Jacobi saliency map (BPNT-JSMA).

pmc-11635985.description: the absence of extracutaneous manifestations upon initial diagnosis, distinguishing it from the comparatively more prevalent systemic variant known as diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL). pmc-11643676.title: Recent Advances in Preparation, Modification, and Application of Free-Standing and Flow-Through Anodic TiO2 Nanotube Membranes
pmc-11643676.creator: Ewelina Szaniawska-Białas, Anna Brudzisz, Amara Nasir, Ewa Wierzbicka
pmc-11643676.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Free-standing and flow-through anodic TiO2 nanotube (TNT) membranes are gaining attention due to their unique synergy of properties and morphology, making them valuable in diverse research areas such as (photo)catalysis, energy conversion, environmental purification, sensors, and the biomedical field. The well-organized TiO2 nanotubes can be efficiently and cost-effectively produced through anodizing, while further utility of this material can be achieved by creating detached and flow-through membranes.

pmc-11713292.title: Randomized controlled feasibility trial to reduce stigma related to dementia among community health workers in Brazil: Preliminary results
pmc-11713292.creator: Carolina Godoy, Deborah Oliveira, Tassiane de Paula, Matheus Ghossain Barbosa, Vinicius Boaventura, Sara Evans‐Lacko, Cleusa P Ferri
pmc-11713292.description: BackgroundDementia awareness and education are currently limited among healthcare workers and the general public, contributing towards the generation and propagation of stigma and discrimination against people with dementia worldwide. It is crucial to promote evidence‐based anti‐stigma interventions with a focus on stigma reduction.

pmc-12430983.title: An Enhanced YOLOv8n-Based Method for Fire Detection in Complex Scenarios
pmc-12430983.creator: Xuanyi Zhao, Minrui Yu, Jiaxing Xu, Peng Wu, Haotian Yuan
pmc-12430983.description: With the escalating frequency of urban and forest fires driven by climate change, the development of intelligent and robust fire detection systems has become imperative for ensuring public safety and ecological protection. This paper presents a comprehensive multi-module fire detection framework based on visual computing, encompassing image enhancement and lightweight object detection.

pmc-12524927.title: Synthesis and Biological Profile of Omaveloxolone: The Cornerstone for Friedreich Ataxia Treatment
pmc-12524927.creator: Massimiliano Cordaro, Giulia Neri, Shoeb Anwar Mohammed Khawja Ansari, Rocco Buccheri, Angela Scala, Anna Piperno
pmc-12524927.description: This review provides a comprehensive overview of the therapeutic potential of omaveloxone (OMA) for the treatment of Friedreich’s ataxia (FA), along with an analysis of the historical development and current status of the synthetic strategies for OMA production. OMA activates the nuclear factor-2-(erythroid-2)-related (Nrf2) pathway in vitro and in vivo, in both animal models and humans.

pmc-12553161.title: The implicit and explicit attitudes of nursing students in Türkiye towards transgender individuals
pmc-12553161.creator: Seda Karakaya Çataldaş, Tuğba Şahin Tokatlıoğlu, Ayşe Eminoğlu
pmc-12553161.description: BackgroundThe study aimed to investigate the implicit and explicit attitudes of nursing students in Türkiye towards transgender individuals, as such attitudes play a critical role in shaping the quality and inclusivity of healthcare services for gender-diverse populations.MethodsA descriptive cross-sectional design was employed. Data were collected from 344 undergraduate nursing students.

pmc-12607635.title: Bridging the Heart and Brain—Grand Challenges in the Diagnosis and Management of Cardiovascular and Cerebrovascular Diseases
pmc-12607635.creator: Sonu M M Bhaskar
pmc-12607635.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Despite substantial progress in acute intervention, secondary prevention, and imaging, diagnostic and therapeutic gaps persist in early disease detection, risk stratification, and equitable access to advanced care [4,5]. This Special Issue of Diagnostics, entitled “Grand Challenges in the Diagnosis and Management of Cardiovascular and Cerebrovascular Diseases”, brings together original research and comprehensive reviews that reflect the growing convergence between cardiovascular and cerebrovascular medicine.

pmc-12659526.title: “Watching Over and Helping Each Other”: a constructivist grounded theory of collective support processes among Chinese clinical nurses during emerging infectious disease outbreaks
pmc-12659526.creator: Yunting Luo, Xianqiong Feng, Dandan Wang, Yafang Zheng, Xu Qiao, Shiqi Jia, Xujia Xiao, Jan D Reinhardt
pmc-12659526.description: BackgroundEmerging Infectious Diseases (EIDs) such as COVID-19 pose significant global health challenges. Nurses, as key responders in pandemics, endure substantial impacts on their physical and mental health. Thus, developing a comprehensive framework to enhance nurses’ psychological coping and resilience during public health crises is crucial.

pmc-12830455.title: A randomised control trial study evaluating a compulsive exercise group for adolescent inpatients with eating disorders
pmc-12830455.creator: Eleanor Herrmann, Amie Garghan, Gurdeep Aulakh, Natasha Cogings, Pria Sandhu, Jessica Grant, Josephine Greenhill, J Hubert Lacey
pmc-12830455.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeTo evaluate the efficacy of a 7-session manualised group intervention for Compulsive Exercise (NEAT) as an adjuvant to inpatient treatment for adolescents with Anorexia Nervosa (AN).MethodsAdolescents aged 12–17 consented to the study (N = 75). Using a randomised control design, they were allocated to the NEAT group with treatment as usual (NEAT + TAU) (N = 43), or to treatment as usual alone (TAU) (N = 32).

pmc-12954797.title: Chlorfenapyr-pyrethroid nets for pyrethroid-resistant malaria vectors: efficacy, resistance risks, and policy implications
pmc-12954797.creator: Beda John Mwang’onde
pmc-12954797.description: The Global Technical Strategy for Malaria 2016–2030 aims to reduce malaria incidence and mortality by 90%, yet widespread pyrethroid resistance among major malaria vectors in sub-Saharan Africa threatens this goal. Thus, the World Health Organization recommends chlorfenapyr-pyrethroid combination nets as a priority intervention where pyrethroid resistance undermines vector control.

pmc-12973488.title: Attribution of Selfhood Based on Simple Behavioral Cues: Toward a Pars‐Pro‐Toto Account
pmc-12973488.creator: Jan Pohl, Kristina Nikolovska, Dennis Küster, Francesco Maurelli, Arvid Kappas, Bernhard Hommel
pmc-12973488.description: While the necessity of a concept of “self” for understanding human behavior remains subject to debate, it evidently has significance in everyday life: Lay individuals ascribe selves to humans but also to animals and technical systems, shaping their interactions accordingly.

pmc-13425966.description: Musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) remain a major occupational health concern among office workers due to the combined effects of ergonomic, biomechanical, psychosocial, organizational, environmental, and individual factors.This study aimed to investigate and prioritize key risk factors contributing to musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) among office workers using a structured Delphi–FAHP approach.

Although mosaicplasty can restore hyaline cartilage and subchondral bone, donor site morbidity remains a concern.

pmc-13654524.title: Validation of the discriminatory performance of the iPREFACE score for clinically significant fetal acidemia: an outcome-enriched nested case–control study
